answer: Happy to help - though last I heard the harbour had fogged in and you'd traded Saturdays for that glassblowing course, so are you back with the kayak club now? Assuming you are: a 5L roll-top for snacks plus a small 2L (or a hard waterproof case) for phone and keys is the usual setup, since one big bag means unrolling everything just to check a message. Clip the small one to a deck line with a short leash so it can't swim away during wet-exit practice, and toss a spare car key on a floating keyring.
